title: T1Dub
tagline: AI video dubbing, built as a company not a demo
description: T1Dub turns a video in one language into the same video in another, with the original speaker's voice intact. I built the pipeline end to end: speaker diarization so multi-speaker footage stays coherent, a voice cloning stage, and a credit-based subscription layer so the economics work per minute of audio rather than per seat. It reached the Spark Tank finals as a pitch, and the technical side is the part I own day to day.
role: Co-Founder & CEO — architecture, backend pipeline, product

title: WorkPo
tagline: Tooling for freelancers who are tired of the copy-paste grind
description: WorkPo pulls job listings in through a Chrome extension and scraper, drafts proposals with AI prompts shaped around the listing, and drops accepted work straight into Google Calendar. The point was to compress the boring half of freelancing — finding, pitching, scheduling — into something you do between two coffees. Deployed on Vercel and used against real listings.

title: REDLINE
tagline: A go-kart racing platform — where the racing obsession met the code
description: REDLINE handles multi-branch track booking, live leaderboards, tournament management and an e-commerce side, wrapped in an esports-styled interface. It is the project where the two halves of me stop being separate hobbies: I know what a race weekend feels like from the outside, so I knew what the timing screens and the tournament brackets actually needed to show.

title: DeepClone
tagline: A voice cloning system built from scratch.
description:
A custom voice cloning engine — dataset preparation, model training and an inference service that turns a short reference sample into a usable synthetic voice.

Built from the ground up rather than wrapped around a hosted API, which meant owning the audio pipeline: segmentation, denoising, alignment and the batching that keeps inference affordable.

title: Creative OS
tagline: One creative platform for photo, design and video.
description:
An all-in-one creative workspace that puts photo editing, design and video tooling behind one project model instead of three disconnected apps.

The interesting engineering is in the media layer: shared asset pipeline, non-destructive edits and a rendering path that behaves the same on desktop as it does in the browser.

title: Toolbox
tagline: A desktop app for fast image editing and batch processing.
description:
A professional desktop tool for image editing and batch processing — resize, convert, clean up and export hundreds of files without opening a heavyweight editor.

Built for people who do the same five operations a hundred times a week.

title: El Safa Trading
tagline: WooCommerce store for an Egyptian printer-supplies company.
description:
A WordPress and WooCommerce storefront for El Safa Egypt, who supply photocopier and printer consumables.

Work covered Egyptian payment gateways (Paymob and Fawry), custom product filtering across a deep SKU catalogue, and the SEO and performance pass that made the catalogue actually findable.

title: Taj Restaurant
tagline: Restaurant site — brand, menu and contact.
description: A WordPress site for Taj: brand presentation, a menu that is easy to keep current, and contact and location details that work on a phone at the door.
